decision.reasoning: The audit shows 2 fatal failures in INFORMATION AND CONFIDENTIALITY, specifically in verification procedures and confidentiality requirements. Per policy, ANY fatal failure immediately triggers escalation regardless of the otherwise strong 88.9% pass rate, as these represent critical compliance and regulatory breaches that cannot be handled through coaching.

agent_output.escalation_reason: Agent with over 365 days tenure committed two FATAL confidentiality breaches by sharing case information without proper verification and with an unauthorized third party, creating immediate regulatory and customer harm exposure
fatal_breaches: INFORMATION AND CONFIDENTIALITY - COMPLIANT TO VERIFICATION PROCEDURES - ID verification not per policy, failed to verify demographics, shared case details without verification

INFORMATION AND CONFIDENTIALITY - COMPLIANT WITH CONFIDENTIALITY REQUIREMENTS - Confidentiality requirements not met for personal and account information, shared case information with an unauthorized third party
risk_impact: Regulatory compliance violation exposing organization to CFPB enforcement action and potential fines for unauthorized disclosure of consumer credit information
Customer PII compromise creating identity theft and fraud exposure
Legal liability from unauthorized third-party disclosure of protected account information
Breach of contractual and statutory confidentiality obligations under consumer credit protection laws
recommended_actions: Immediate removal of agent from production queue pending investigation
Compliance team to conduct full incident investigation and determine scope of unauthorized disclosures
Review all recent calls by this agent for additional verification or confidentiality failures
Assess customer notification requirements and potential harm mitigation steps
Mandatory re-certification on verification protocols and confidentiality requirements before return to production
Document incident for regulatory reporting assessment
